scenes.text: Why it sucks being an... Arsenal fan!
It starts when you're six. Your dad tells you about the Invincibles. A whole season. Unbeaten. He tells you again. Every Sunday. For the rest of your life.
Age nine. Champions League final in Paris! Your keeper gets sent off after eighteen minutes. You lose 2-1. But hey... great atmosphere.
Age twelve. You finish second. Behind Leicester. Yes. That Leicester. Five thousand to one Leicester.
Age fourteen. You're top of the league. For two hundred and forty-eight days. You start planning the parade. You finish second.
Age fifteen. Second again. Age sixteen. Second again. Your friends start calling you "Silver."
Age seventeen. The manager says: "Trust the process." You trust it. Your dad trusts it. Your dad's dad trusts it.
That's the thing about being an Arsenal fan. You're always so close.
So close you can almost touch it. Next season. Definitely.
Tag an Arsenal fan who still trusts the process. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
